card.name: HP ending the plasticizer DEHP
card.fires_on: The final piece "HP" of the abbreviation DEHP, written in brackets after di(2-ethylhexyl)phthalate in IV bag and tubing warnings. It also fires weakly on the end of a few other abbreviations or numbers, such as pregnane-X or plutonium-239.

modes.label: DEHP abbreviation
modes.description: The closing letters of DEHP right after the full name of the plasticizer in infusion-material notes.
modes.example: with di-(2-ethylhexyl)phthalate (DE<<HP>>) infusion bag with 18 mL

modes.label: Other name endings
modes.description: The last piece of a technical name or isotope number, a weaker and rarer case.

card.plain: It marks the end of the abbreviation DEHP, the plastic softener named in IV bag and tubing warnings.
